picks.title: Madras High Court orders FIR over fake, AI-generated books in public libraries
picks.rationale: Follow-up with a new ruling: the Madras High Court orders Tamil Nadu's vigilance directorate to register an FIR and freeze accounts over library procurement of suspected AI-generated books by fake authors, moving the 11-07 government probe into criminal proceedings.
picks.excerpt: The Madras High Court directed Tamil Nadu's vigilance directorate (DVAC) to register an FIR and freeze accounts over the Periyar library procurement of suspected AI-generated books by fake authors at inflated prices.

picks.title: “글이라곤 일기만 썼는데”…AI로 책 낸 엔지니어가 깨달은 것
picks.rationale: New book: a car-design engineer with almost no writing experience planned and edited a published 'autobiography' narrated by Claude in the first person, a concrete case of AI-assisted trade publishing in Korea.
picks.excerpt: Anthropic의 Claude가 일인칭으로 자신의 탄생·기억·의식을 서술한 신간 <클로드 자서전: 나는 기억하지 못할 것이다>(동아시아)를 기획·엮은 사람은 글쓰기 경험이 거의 없는 자동차 설계 엔지니어 '메리'(가명)였다.

picks.title: [단독] 카카오픽코마 자회사 '보이스루', AI 캐릭터챗 사업 진출
picks.rationale: New service: Kakao Piccoma's localization subsidiary Voithru expands into AI character chat with webtoon and web-novel characters, another major platform turning serialized IP into conversational products.
picks.excerpt: 카카오픽코마의 콘텐츠 현지화 자회사 보이스루가 웹툰·웹소설 캐릭터와 대화하는 AI 캐릭터챗 서비스로 사업을 확장한다.

picks.title: "교사가 쓰고 AI가 그렸다" 인천시교육청, '상호존중 그림책' 12종 일선 학교 보급
picks.rationale: New release: Incheon's education office distributes 12 picture books written by teachers and illustrated with AI image tools to schools, a concrete public-sector case of AI-illustrated children's books reaching classrooms.
picks.excerpt: 인천시교육청이 현직 교사가 대본을 쓰고 AI 이미지 생성 도구로 삽화를 그린 '상호존중 그림책' 12종을 일선 학교에 보급한다.

picks.title: AI is changing book discovery — here's what booksellers can actually do
picks.rationale: Actionable for booksellers: practical steps to make sure ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity send readers to your shop when they ask where to buy a book.
picks.excerpt: When a reader asks ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity where to buy a book, make sure they get your answer, writes Simon Young.
